svg.title: coverage ndsdd2
svg.desc: Coverage of Non-Deterministic Spec-Driven Development: Enterprise Edition, Second Edition. A business need becomes an explicit specification and implementation evidence. Public frameworks and patterns, enterprise coordination, templates, playbooks and process economics support the work. Passing a gate does not replace independent checks and accountable acceptance.
svg.text: Turn business intent into specifications, coordinated work and evidence.
From public frameworks to enterprise practice
A passed gate is evidence. Acceptance still needs independent checks and an owner.
